statement.p: Sketch a graph of f(x) to confirm your answers.

static.solution:
f(x) is shown below.
From this, and from the given formula for f(x), we can see that
\lim\limits_{x\to 4^{+}}\, f(x) = 11, and
\lim\limits_{x\to 4^{-}}\, f(x) = 11.
These are the same value, so we know that the limit must exist: \lim\limits_{x\to 4}\, f(x) = 11.
Note, however, that f(x) is not continuous at x=4 since f(4)=5 \ne 11.
